"I would recommend my managerâ€ is a broad topic. In order to address it effectively you will need to narrow in on your key improvement opportunities.

### Communicate with your team

Let them know how much you appreciate them for giving their candid feedback on the survey. Share with them how committed your are to improving, that you are going to spend a couple of weeks zeroing in on an improvement opportunity, and that you will continue to need their candid feedback as you do that.

### Assess yourself

Spend 30 minutes this week thinking about your strengths and weaknesses as a manager. Use this [Manager Self-Assessment](Glint_Manager_Manager_Self-Assessment) to create a summary of your current status and goals for improvement.

Then seek candid advice from someone you trust at work on your assessment of yourself and on your proposed goals.

### Ask your team for feedback

Share your self-assessment and proposed solutions with your team. Ask them to help you select your single most important improvement goal.

### Commit to one thing

Once you've determined your most important goal, set achievable and measurable milestones that will help you achieve it. Seek feedback along the way from your team and others you trust.
